findings.message: Refresh the acceptance fence when an explicit resume save fails after replacement.
findings.rationale: After an initial acceptance failure leaves the accepted candidate visible, explicit resume changes its status from running to pending and removes active execution metadata before saving. If that save replaces the file but fails its durability acknowledgement, the original fence remains unchanged. A subsequent resume on the same coordinator rejects the newly written checkpoint because it matches neither original snapshot, even though its accepted mapping, decisions and identities are unchanged. This prevents normal explicit recovery after storage becomes healthy. Reconcile recovery-save failures against their own prior/candidate snapshots while preserving the fence. Add a regression covering initial acceptance failure, post-replacement resume failure, then successful resume on the same coordinator for both routes.

testCoverage.explanation: Inspected the bodies and assertions of all nine supplied test files.
